name: service countdown
static_effect: zero clears the bank-1 service countdown

name: persist configuration checksum
static_effect: recomputes and writes checksum bytes to data EEPROM A00/A01

name: telemetry suppression enable
static_effect: sets the telemetry-suppression flag and loads countdown 0x78

name: telemetry suppression disable
static_effect: clears telemetry suppression and parser scratch bytes

name: front-panel LEDs
static_effect: copies value to the LED output routine

name: convection fan
static_effect: copies value to the convection-fan target

name: exhaust fan
static_effect: scales value through the exhaust phase-control routine

name: igniter follow-up
static_effect: enters the second igniter follow-up routine

name: feed motor/sensor
static_effect: uses the high nibble as the feed-test drive parameter

name: controller service
static_effect: runs a service routine and rewrites RAM 0x43 mode bits; exact purpose unresolved

name: igniter workflow
static_effect: enters igniter workflow, sets countdown 0x82, emits I plus LF

name: remote buttons
static_effect: stores the value as a synthetic panel-button code
